about.title: A historical game, reconstructed
about.body: This product follows a documented Senterej profile and keeps its historical source decisions visible.
about.profile: Senterej was played in Ethiopia and Eritrea. This digital edition uses the historical 8×8 game described by Walter Plowden in 1868, with later scholarship as corroboration.
about.conventions: Sources differ on whether Werera ends at any capture or only a pawn capture. This edition ends it at the first capture, uses a one-step diagonal Ferz, promotes Medeq automatically to Ferz, and treats the first ordinary turn as belonging to the player who did not capture.
about.provenance: The piece art, tutorial, rules wording and interface are original. Historical sources are linked for provenance, not copied into the product.
